judgment.notes: Only H001, N005-N008, supplied definitions and earlier F001-F003 are used. F001 is established without comparison assumptions. L1 supplies exactly the quantitative antecedent and is discharged in S004. The projected comparison and its error are confined to S002; F002 exports bounds for the original stages and q_n, so no private object escapes. No new hypothesis, producer proof, circular dependency or absent conservation result is used. The R>0 clause of H001 is retained but unused locally.

The stage formulas, Sobolev norms, X norm, residual increments and grid identify all objects actually used. The comparison solution is used only through its smooth sample w=v(t_n); no PDE or mean-zero property of v is required. The export retains its original comparison conditions, constants and every partial endpoint. Derivatives are stepwise and a.e. globally, consistently with the piecewise regularity.

scope: Coverage is reviewer-reported; reading alone is not mathematical assessment.
